com.ibm.cos.v2.retries.api

Interface RetryToken

  • All Known Implementing Classes:
    DefaultRetryToken

    @ThreadSafe
public interface RetryToken
    An opaque token representing an in-progress execution.

    Created via RetryStrategy.acquireInitialToken(com.ibm.cos.v2.retries.api.AcquireInitialTokenRequest) before a first attempt and refreshed after each attempt failure via RetryStrategy.refreshRetryToken(com.ibm.cos.v2.retries.api.RefreshRetryTokenRequest).

    Released via RetryStrategy.recordSuccess(com.ibm.cos.v2.retries.api.RecordSuccessRequest) after a successful attempt.
